title: The Keeper
author: Test
article:
The lighthouse keeper, Mara, had lived on the island for eleven years. Every evening she climbed the ninety steps to light the lamp. 

One winter a storm wrecked a supply boat on the northern rocks. Mara rowed out alone and rescued the two sailors, though she broke her wrist doing it.
